text:
I haven't made any edits, because I can't write this change without seeing `app/src/parts.ts`. I only have its path, and a SEARCH block has to match the file's text exactly. A guess would be refused or, worse, would break the method.

Three things in the file decide how the change has to be written:

- **How `history` is written now:** its parameter names and types, and how it builds and copies its result.
- **How the store records when a movement was logged:** this could be a sequence number, a logged-at timestamp, or just the order of entries in an array. The change must pick the last-recorded movements by this, not by day number.
- **What order `history` returns movements in now:** it may be sorted by day number. In that case I would choose the latest N by logging order, then put them back into the current order.

Please paste `src/parts.ts`, or at least the `PartsStore` class and the movement type. I'll then give you the exact edit. It will add `limit?: number`, return exactly what the method returns now when there is no limit or the part has no more movements than the limit, and otherwise return copies of the last-logged movements in the current order.
